value.rationale: An important known preintegration criterion was described as less tractable and approximated by an active-subspace eigenvector; the theorem replaces its global direction search by one scalar strongly convex eigenvalue minimization, yields constructive all-optima and error certificates, and exhibits an exact zero-variance direction with nonzero residual under the usual proxy. This is an analytically complete nontrivial algorithm-design result with a natural infinite-dimensional matrix-parameter family.
